limitations: A small deterministic ordered subset is not the full Train/Validation population and may not represent tail conditions.
Local CPU torch differs from native CUDA torch; activation diagnostics are exploratory and do not replace native recorded evaluation.
Attention arithmetic counterfactual does not establish prediction improvement or causal explanation.
No per-branch gradient histories, Train raw full-population errors or paired row predictions were recorded during training.

activation.interpretation: Same trained candidate and same block input; diagnostic arithmetic only, not historical CNN and not a new model performance evaluation. Norm-preserved direction computes only attention scores; no replacement forward or optimizer.
